name: DragRemeasure
description: Measures every drop target again once an item's move into another list has rendered. dnd-kit's own observers skip targets whose size didn't change, even when they moved. Render it inside the `DndContext`.

props.name: version
props.description: Anything that changes when an item moves list, such as the lists' items.

name: DragLift
description: The copy of a dragged item that follows the hand (design/patterns/drag-and-drop.md#what-follows-the-hand): an opaque popover surface with `shadow-float` and a `line-seam` ring, no scale and no tilt, 1:1 with the pointer from the grab point, never clamped to its container and never held to one axis. On a drop it glides into its place, and on a cancel back home (160ms, `motion-drag-settle-*`; none with reduced motion).

props.name: autoScroll
props.description: Scroll whatever scrollable area the pointer comes within 48px of the edge of. Turn dnd-kit's own off (`<DndContext autoScroll={false}>`) so the two don't scroll together.

props.name: children
props.description: The lifted copy: the dragged item itself, or a compact proxy for a large one. Nothing while nothing is lifted.

props.name: container
props.description: Render the copy in another element, such as `document.body` when an ancestor has a transform. By default it renders in place (it is `position: fixed`).

props.name: modifiers
props.description: Modifiers for the copy only, such as one that keeps a compact proxy under the hand.

name: DragRefusalHint
description: Shown while the hand is over a place that refuses the item (design/patterns/drag-and-drop.md#refused-places): the reason, in a HUD chip by the pointer (by the lifted copy in a keyboard drag), and the not-allowed cursor. Render it only while the place is refused, inside the `DndContext`, with no placeholder anywhere. Announce the reason as well: the chip is not read out.

props.name: children
props.description: Why the place under the hand won't take the item, such as "Can't move from Todo to Done".

props.name: container
props.description: Render the hint in another element; by default it renders in `document.body`.

name: DropPlaceholder
description: Where a dragged item will land (design/patterns/drag-and-drop.md#where-it-will-land): a 1.5px dashed `line-strong` outline on `fill-subtle`, with the item's radius and size. One look for every place. The control radius is the default; pass the item's own (`rounded-container` for a card). Hidden from assistive technology: the announcements say where the item is.

props.name: opaque
props.description: Over live content (a panel, a column of a layout): an opaque `layer-canvas` under the `fill-subtle` wash, so the content under it never shows through.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

name: DragLiveRegion
description: A polite, visually hidden live region for drag announcements.

name: DraggedSlot
description: Wraps each item's content in a list. The dragged item's own node is at 40% while it is still home, and the dashed place (its size, its radius) once it stands anywhere else. Every other item renders as it is: the wrapper stays the same, so the item keeps focus when its drag starts.

props.name: dragging
props.description: This item is the one being dragged. Render the slot around every item and pass `isDragging`, so the dragged one keeps its node (and focus).

props.name: home
props.description: The dragged item still stands at its own place.

props.name: radius
props.description: The item's radius class, for the place: `rounded-control` by default.
